new_value: SOS CoAP resource (/sos) is fully implemented in emergency.py with SosResource class. POST activates with origin signature verification, DELETE cancels with auth, GET/Observe expose state to all subscribers. The retrigger() method supports 30s periodic beacons. Supporting modules sos_origin.py and sos_relay.py handle cross-relay authentication and TTL-limited deduplication. Comprehensive tests exist in test_sos_resource.py, test_sos_origin.py, and test_sos_relay.py.
